appearance_facts.fact: Chart title is 'Month vs. Number of cases'.
X-axis displays dates from 'Jan 27 to Mar 22, 2020' with tick marks for specific dates including 'Mar 04, 2020', 'Mar 05, 2020', ..., 'Mar 22, 2020'.
The data line is blue with circular markers at each data point.
The data line starts near 0 cases on 'Mar 04, 2020' and ends at approximately 1400 cases on 'Mar 22, 2020'.
The data line shows a downward trend from 'Mar 04, 2020' to 'Mar 22, 2020'.
The data line is plotted on a light blue shaded background.
